description: Use when assessing small business lending opportunity in a market, benchmarking a bank's SBA production against competitors, evaluating CRA lending performance by geography, or identifying industries with unmet capital needs. Returns SBA 7(a) and 504 loan approval data — counts, amounts, average sizes, top lenders, and industry concentration by state and NAICS sector. Example: Illinois manufacturing sector — 847 SBA loans approved in 2023, $425K average, top 3 lenders holding 31% market share — 69% of market accessible to community bank competition. Source: SBA Public Loan Disclosure Data. $0.10 USDC per call.
name: get_sba_loan_market_data
title: Get Sba Loan Market Data
